svg.text: Two components carry every screen: the CUBE and the ORBIT. Five small pieces sit around them. Nothing else is allowed on a frame.
one cube, five sizes, five states
mirrors the cube in your hand
a fixed case; unknown stickers dark
pieces outlined: teal focus, amber wrong
the face to turn is lit; the move is named beside it
states are layered on one cube: live (the cube) + case (a drill) + replay (a position) are sources; highlight and cue are overlays on any of them.
one ring, one API, a new meaning per flow
outer label: name · value · delta · marker line
Orbit({ cx, cy, r, start, sweep,
